extracted.name: Chocolate Pudding Shots
extracted.description: These chocolate pudding shots made with pudding mix, milk, vodka, and Irish cream liqueur are a fun alternative to Jell-O shots at your next party.
ingredient_lines: 1 (3.9 ounce) package instant chocolate pudding mix
1 (8 ounce) container frozen whipped topping, thawed
instruction_lines: Beat cold milk and pudding mix in a bowl with an electric mixer until smooth and beginning to thicken, 1 to 2 minutes. Stir in Irish cream liqueur and vodka, then fold in whipped topping until smooth.
Spoon into 16 small cups. Serve immediately, or refrigerate or freeze until ready to serve.
